title: Six hundred thousand
note: One mark is a thousand reports. Seven are left.

beats.sub: Six hundred marks. Six hundred thousand.
Two units of prayer before admitting each one.
Seven marks out of six hundred.

beats.text: This is what a source means
beats.sub: A chain, a biography, and a reason to refuse.
